title: Viral Tweets Tracker input
description: Find the X (Twitter) posts, videos and articles getting the most likes, reposts and views for your topics, for chosen accounts, or for what's trending. Runs on the official X API with your own Bearer Token, so X bills its reads to your X developer account.

xBearerToken.title: X API Bearer Token
xBearerToken.description: Your own X API Bearer Token. At console.x.com, create an app, add pay-per-use credits, then copy the Bearer Token from the app's "Keys and tokens" page. It's stored encrypted, sent only to api.x.com and never logged. X bills your developer account for what each search returns, at its own prices (October 2026: $0.005 a post, $0.010 a user profile). Without a token the run only explains this, free.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Keywords, #hashtags, $cashtags or @mentions. Each one is its own search. Several words are searched as an exact phrase; write your own X search query (with OR, quotes or operators like url:) for anything else. Leave Topics and Accounts empty to search what's trending instead.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: X handles (like "nasa", "@nasa" or "x.com/nasa") whose posts that pass the filters below you want back. Accounts are searched together in as few searches as fit X's 512-character query limit.

trendsLocation.title: Trends from
trendsLocation.sectionCaption: Trending (used only when Topics and Accounts are empty)
trendsLocation.description: Where X's trending topics come from. Each trend becomes one search, and the trends themselves are saved as free rows. X bills one trends request at $0.010.

trendCount.title: Number of trends
trendCount.description: How many of the top trends to search, from 1 to 20.

contentType.title: Content
contentType.description: Which posts to keep. Videos means native X videos. Articles keeps X Articles and posts that link to a page outside X; X still returns, and bills, the other posts with links, which are then left out.

minLikes.title: Minimum likes
minLikes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes, 0 or more. X applies it in the search itself, so posts below it are never returned or billed.

minReposts.title: Minimum reposts
minReposts.description: Only posts with at least this many reposts, 0 or more (0 means no minimum). Applied by X in the search.

minReplies.title: Minimum replies
minReplies.description: Only posts with at least this many replies, 0 or more (0 means no minimum). Applied by X in the search.

sinceHours.title: Posted in the last (hours)
sinceHours.description: How far back to look, from 1 to 168 hours. X's recent search reaches back 7 days.

language.title: Language
language.description: Only posts X classifies as this language: a two-letter code like "en", "es" or "ja". Leave empty for every language.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Also return replies that pass the filters. Off by default, so you get original posts and quotes. Reposts are never returned; the original post is.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified accounts only
verifiedOnly.description: Only posts from accounts X marks as verified.

maxPostsPerSearch.title: Max posts per search
maxPostsPerSearch.description: Most posts each topic, trend or account group returns, from 10 to 500. X picks the most relevant first. This caps what X bills too.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of the saved posts across all searches.

includeAuthorDetails.title: Include author details
includeAuthorDetails.description: Each post's author handle, name, followers and verified badge, plus views per follower. Turn off to save on X's bill, where user profiles cost more than posts; post links then use x.com/i/status/ID.

onlyNew.title: Only posts not returned before
onlyNew.description: For scheduled runs: skip posts an earlier run with this on already returned (remembered in a key-value store in your account named viral-tweets-tracker-seen). Skipped posts aren't charged here, but X still bills their read.
